name: BorgWarner
outlook:
What BorgWarner says to expect

  • Full year 2026: GAAP operating marginU.S. GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 9.3% to 9.6% in 2026. Excluding the impact of non-comparable items and the add-back of intangible asset amortization expense, adjusted operating margin is expected to be in the range of 10.7% to 10.9%.
  • Full year 2026: net earnings per shareU.S. GAAP net earnings are expected to be within the range of $4.65 to $4.84 per diluted share. Excluding the impact of non-comparable items, adjusted net earnings are expected to be in the range of $5.20 to $5.35 per diluted share, compared with the Company’s previous adjusted net earnings guidance range of $5.05 to $5.30 per diluted share.
  • Full year 2026: operating and free cash flowFull year operating cash flow is expected to be in the range of $1,600 million to $1,700 million, while free cash flow is expected to be in the range of $900 million to $1,100 million, consistent with the Company’s previous guidance.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
